items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: That was on Pedida. Pedida between, uh, between, uh, Franklin and Liberty Franklin.

ctx.x: That was on Pedida. Pedida between, uh, between, uh, Franklin and Liberty Franklin. Tintop. Tintop. On the left hand side. Small hall, eh? Still in? Oh, no, that thing is gone. Oh, yeah.
Oh, yeah. It wouldn't have been Kenny's Hall, the one they called Quenky Butt Hall.
